A Stand-Up Paddleboard (SUP) experience on Lake Naguri is a gentle eco-tour for body and mind. Feel the seasonal natural beauty and peaceful lakeside with your whole self.

【Fee】
4,000 yen per person (includes guide, insurance, and SUP board rental)

【Capacity】
5 people

【Guide】
Staff from Naguri Canoe Workshop (Certified NPO)

【What to bring】
Towel, change of clothes, water shoes if desired (barefoot is okay too)

【More information】
Naguri Canoe Workshop (Certified NPO) website: https://naguri-canoe.co.jp/
